_why: X04 / F13#5. A blind normal-camera verdict found Tidewake's docks read as 'a fence and two slabs on sand' rather than lived destinations (ART_DIRECTION Tidewake: 'Docks read as lived destinations'). This presentation-only layer dresses every water_world.json dock's departure anchor from installed families: a plank pier over the water beside (never across) the swim lane, lantern posts with a small warm light, and a landward cargo cluster. No collision on the route, no red (Team Tether's colour), no new assets. There is no installed boat, rowboat or raft in any family, so none is placed; boats need owner-supplied reference art.

pier._why_post_tint: The installed log is atlas-textured (Kenney colormap) and read oxblood-maroon (~RGB 102,41,24) even under a multiply; posts take a flat dark wet-timber material instead (ART_DIRECTION Tidewake: wet dark rock and timber; red is Team Tether's).

lanterns._why_glow: The lantern model is trim-sheet textured with no emissive surface; a blind pass read it as an unlit white box. It takes a warm emissive material and a stronger omni light.

cargo._why_variants: Each dock takes one of these item subsets (by dock index) with a per-dock yaw so the docks stop reading as one repeated template.

_why_deck_cargo: A blind pass found nothing on the pier itself said anyone used it; a barrel, crate and rope sit at its seaward end, inside the deck width.
